description: SO-ARM101 dimensions in metres used by pick_sim, hand_map and guidedfit. Defaults come from the official SO-101 URDF (follower arm). Measure this leader arm with a ruler and replace them; 'measured' says which values are real measurements.

how_to_measure.shoulder_height_m: table surface (where the base is clamped) straight up to the centre of the shoulder-lift motor shaft
how_to_measure.shoulder_forward_m: horizontal distance from the base-rotation axis to the shoulder-lift shaft, toward the arm
how_to_measure.upper_arm_m: shoulder-lift shaft centre to elbow shaft centre
how_to_measure.forearm_m: elbow shaft centre to wrist-flex shaft centre
how_to_measure.hand_m: wrist-flex shaft centre to the point that touches the item; on this leader arm, the bottom of the handle
